title: Climbing stairs
statement: Start simple: Return how many ways you can climb exactly steps stairs, taking 1 or 2 steps at a time. Zero steps has one way: do nothing. The theory is optional. The C solution appears after the hidden tests pass.
think: Write the ways for 0, 1, and 2 by hand.
The last move is either one step or two steps.
Only the previous two answers are needed for the next one.
hints: The base cases are ways(0) = 1 and ways(1) = 1.
Each later answer is the sum of the two before it.
Two variables replace an array of every step.
